reuse.why: Adds a shared isDailyWeekendSkip predicate and uses it in the server sites, but getNextDate, which defines it alongside, re-inlines the same skipWeekend && frequency === 'daily' test twice instead of calling it.

duplication.why: The daily-skip condition is written inline twice in getNextDate and evaluated twice per date in getUpcomingDates, and each site keeps its own skip-vs-move branching around getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

placement.why: The predicate and the skip search sit in shared/schedules.ts with the other weekend helpers; server modules import them as before.

scope.why: Touches only the three weekend-rule sites, the recur data passed through rule-utils, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Behaviour is understandable, but schedule-template's `moveWeekend || !skipWeekend` argument to noSkipWeekend is convoluted and the weekend policy is still spread across three call sites with different shapes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts tests value.schedule.data.frequency === 'daily' inline (twice) rather than using the isDailyWeekendSkip helper the same diff exports.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated daily-skip conditions are plain restatements, not disguised copies.

one_place.where: The new rule is split: isDailyWeekendSkip (shared/schedules.ts) for getUpcomingDates and schedule-template, inline conditions in getNextDate, and each site still decides whether to move with its own ternary around getDateWithSkippedWeekend.
